questions.questionTextEn: Upon one-electron ionization of O2 to form O2⁺ and of N2 to form N2⁺, how do their bond lengths change?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Molecular Orbital Theory (Diatomics) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
Upon one-electron ionization of O2 to form O2⁺ and of N2 to form N2⁺, how do their bond lengths change?
optionsEn: O–O bond length decreases in O2⁺, while N–N bond length increases in N2⁺
O–O bond length increases in O2⁺, while N–N bond length decreases in N2⁺
optionsHi: O–O bond length decreases में O2⁺, while N–N bond length increases में N2⁺
O–O bond length increases में O2⁺, while N–N bond length decreases में N2⁺
questions.explanationEn: In O2, an electron is removed from an antibonding π* orbital, increasing bond order from 2.0 to 2.5 and shortening the bond. In N2, an electron is removed from a bonding σ_{2p} orbital, decreasing bond order from 3.0 to 2.5 and lengthening the bond.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
In O2, an electron is removed from an antibonding π* orbital, increasing bond order from 2.0 to 2.5 and shortening the bond. In N2, an electron is removed from a bonding σ_{2p} orbital, decreasing bond order from 3.0 to 2.5 and lengthening the bond.

questions.questionTextEn: For an elementary chemical reaction, a plot of ln(k) versus 1/T yields a straight line with a negative slope equal to −6000 K. The activation energy E_a of the reaction (in kJ mol⁻¹, given R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) is approximately:

आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

From ln(k) = ln(A) − (E_a / R)(1/T), the slope is −E_a / R = −6000 K => E_a = 6000 K × 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ = 49,884 J mol⁻¹ ≈ 49.9 kJ mol⁻¹.

The total number of stereoisomers (including meso forms and enantiomers) possible के लिए 2,3-dibromobutane (CH3–CHBr–CHBr–CH3) is ________.

2,3-dibromobutane is a symmetrical molecule with 2 chiral centers, giving 2^(2−1) + 2^(0) = 3 stereoisomers (one pair of enantiomers + one achiral meso form).

questions.questionTextEn: In a face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of metallic gold (Au), the total effective number of Au atoms per unit cell is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Physical Chemistry (Unit Cell Stoichiometry) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
में a face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of metallic gold (Au), the total effective number of Au atoms per unit cell is ________.
questions.explanationEn: 8 corner atoms × (1/8) + 6 face-centered atoms × (1/2) = 1 + 3 = 4 atoms per FCC unit cell.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (4.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
8 corner atoms × (1/8) + 6 face-centered atoms × (1/2) = 1 + 3 = 4 atoms per FCC unit cell.

questions.questionTextEn: In the high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum of chloroethane (CH3–CH2–Cl), the quartet signal of the –CH2– protons splits into how many peaks?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Organic Chemistry (1H NMR Multiplicity) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
में the high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum of chloroethane (CH3–CH2–Cl), the quartet signal of the –CH2– protons splits into how many peaks?

By the (n + 1) rule, the –CH2– protons coupled to 3 equivalent –CH3 protons split into 3 + 1 = 4 peaks (a 1:3:3:1 quartet).

questions.questionTextEn: The molar ionic strength I (in mol L⁻¹) of an aqueous solution that is 0.10 M in NaCl and 0.20 M in CaCl2 is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Electrochemistry (Debye-Hückel Ionic Strength) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
The molar ionic strength I (में mol L⁻¹) of an जलीय विलयन (aqueous solution) that is 0.10 M में NaCl and 0.20 M में CaCl2 is ________.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (0.7..0.7) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
From 0.10 M NaCl: [Na⁺] = 0.10 M, [Cl⁻] = 0.10 M. From 0.20 M CaCl2: [Ca²⁺] = 0.20 M, [Cl⁻] = 0.40 M. Total [Cl⁻] = 0.50 M. Ionic strength I = (1/2) Σ c_i z_i² = (1/2)[0.10(1)² + 0.20(2)² + 0.50(−1)²] = (1/2)[0.10 + 0.80 + 0.50] = 0.70 M.

questions.questionTextEn: A radioactive isotope undergoes first-order decay with a half-life t_{1/2} = 15 minutes. The time (in minutes) required for 87.5% of the initial sample to decay (leaving 12.5% unreacted) is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Chemical Kinetics (First-Order Half-Life) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
A radioactive isotope undergoes first-order decay with a अर्ध-आयु (half-life) t_{1/2} = 15 minutes. The time (में minutes) required के लिए 87.5% of the initial sample to decay (leaving 12.5% unreacted) is ________.
questions.explanationEn: Leaving 12.5% = 1/8 = (1/2)³ of the initial sample requires exactly 3 half-lives: t = 3 × 15 min = 45 minutes.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (45.0..45.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
Leaving 12.5% = 1/8 = (1/2)³ of the initial sample requires exactly 3 half-lives: t = 3 × 15 min = 45 minutes.

questions.questionTextEn: A reversible Carnot heat engine operates between a hot reservoir at 600 K and a cold sink at 300 K. If the engine absorbs 120 kJ of heat from the hot reservoir per cycle, the maximum work output W (in kJ) per cycle is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Thermodynamics (Carnot Engine Efficiency) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
A reversible Carnot heat engine operates between a hot reservoir at 600 K and a cold sink at 300 K. यदि the engine absorbs 120 kJ of heat from the hot reservoir per cycle, the maximum work output W (में kJ) per cycle is ________.
questions.explanationEn: Carnot efficiency η = 1 − T_C / T_H = 1 − 300 / 600 = 0.50. Thus W = η Q_H = 0.50 × 120 kJ = 60 kJ.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (60.0..60.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
Carnot efficiency η = 1 − T_C / T_H = 1 − 300 / 600 = 0.50. Thus W = η Q_H = 0.50 × 120 kJ = 60 kJ.

questions.questionTextEn: Pure (S)-(+)-2-butanol has a specific rotation [α]_D = +13.5°. A non-racemic sample of 2-butanol containing 80% of the (S)-(+) enantiomer and 20% of the (R)-(−) enantiomer has an observed specific rotation (in degrees, rounded to one decimal place) of ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Stereochemistry (Enantiomeric Excess & Specific Rotation) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
Pure (S)-(+)-2-butanol has a specific rotation [α]_D = +13.5°. A non-racemic sample of 2-butanol containing 80% of the (S)-(+) enantiomer and 20% of the (R)-(−) enantiomer has an observed specific rotation (में degrees, rounded to one decimal place) of ________.
questions.explanationEn: Enantiomeric excess ee = 80% − 20% = 60% = 0.60. Observed specific rotation = 0.60 × (+13.5°) = +8.1°.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (8.1..8.1) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
Enantiomeric excess ee = 80% − 20% = 60% = 0.60. Observed specific rotation = 0.60 × (+13.5°) = +8.1°.

questions.questionTextEn: An aqueous solution of a transition-metal complex with molar absorptivity ε = 4000 L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ shows an absorbance A = 0.80 in a cuvette of path length l = 1.0 cm. The molar concentration of the complex (in mmol L⁻¹) is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Bioinorganic & Analytical Chemistry (Lambert-Beer Law) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
An जलीय विलयन (aqueous solution) of a transition-metal संकुल (complex) with molar absorptivity ε = 4000 L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹ shows an absorbance A = 0.80 में a cuvette of path length l = 1.0 cm. The molar concentration of the संकुल (complex) (में mmol L⁻¹) is ________.
questions.explanationEn: By the Beer-Lambert Law, c = A / (ε l) = 0.80 / (4000 × 1.0) = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol L⁻¹ = 0.20 mmol L⁻¹.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (0.2..0.2) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
By the Beer-Lambert Law, c = A / (ε l) = 0.80 / (4000 × 1.0) = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol L⁻¹ = 0.20 mmol L⁻¹.

questions.questionTextEn: In the dirhenium octachloride dianion [Re2Cl8]²⁻ (with eclipsed D_{4h} geometry and Re(III) 5d⁴ centers), the formal Re–Re bond order is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:

प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
में the dirhenium octachloride dianion [Re2Cl8]²⁻ (with eclipsed D_{4h} geometry and Re(III) 5d⁴ centers), the formal Re–Re bond order is ________.
questions.explanationEn: Each Re(III) is 5d⁴, contributing 8 d-electrons to the metal-metal manifold in the configuration σ² π⁴ δ² δ*⁰, giving a quadruple (bond order = 4) Re–Re bond.

Each Re(III) is 5d⁴, contributing 8 d-electrons to the metal-metal manifold in the configuration σ² π⁴ δ² δ*⁰, giving a quadruple (bond order = 4) Re–Re bond.

questions.questionTextEn: When 2.00 mol of an ideal gas expands isothermally and reversibly at T = 300 K from V1 = 10.0 L to V2 = 100.0 L (given R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ and ln 10 = 2.303), the magnitude of work done by the gas |w| (in kJ, rounded to two decimal places) is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Physical Chemistry (Ideal Gas Isothermal Expansion) • IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
When 2.00 mol of an ideal gas expands isothermally and reversibly at T = 300 K from V1 = 10.0 L to V2 = 100.0 L (given R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ and ln 10 = 2.303), the magnitude of work done by the gas |w| (में kJ, rounded to two decimal places) is ________.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Chemistry (CY) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (11.48) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
|w| = n R T ln(V2/V1) = 2.00 × 8.314 × 300 × 2.303 = 11488.3 J ≈ 11.49 kJ.

questions.questionTextEn: The Effective Atomic Number (EAN, total electron count including core electrons of Ni, Z = 28) of nickel in tetracarbonylnickel(0), [Ni(CO)4], is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:

प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
The Effective Atomic Number (EAN, total electron count including core electrons of Ni, Z = 28) of nickel में tetracarbonylnickel(0), [Ni(CO)4], is ________.

विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
EAN = Z − oxidation state + 2 × (number of CO ligands) = 28 − 0 + 8 = 36 (Krypton configuration).

For non-linear CH4 with N = 5 atoms, vibrational normal modes = 3(5) − 6 = 9.
